WCG-320.name: Empty Alley Hunter
WCG-320.text: [Arrow: ↑] While ↑ doesn't point at a monster, Taunt can't stop this monster, and it gets +1 DP when attacking the enemy player.
WCG-320.zh_text: 【箭頭：↑】↑ 沒有指向怪物時，嘲諷擋不住此怪物，且它攻擊敵方玩家時 DP +1。

WCG-321.name: Barricade Observer
WCG-321.text: [Arrow: ↑] On deploy: if ↑ points at a monster, return it to its owner's hand; it must cost 2 or less. If ↑ doesn't point at a monster, draw 1 card instead.
WCG-321.zh_text: 【箭頭：↑】進場：若 ↑ 指向怪物，將它移回其擁有者的手牌；它的費用必須在 2 以下。若 ↑ 沒有指向怪物，改為抽 1 張牌。

WCG-322.name: Gale Through the Lanes
WCG-322.text: 1 of your monsters gets +300 PP this turn; if there is no enemy monster directly opposite it, ready it.
WCG-322.zh_text: 使 1 隻己方怪物本回合 PP +300；若它正對面沒有敵方怪物，它轉為直立。

WCG-323.name: Clear-the-Road Edict
WCG-323.text: Return 1 enemy monster to its owner's hand; it must be directly opposite 1 of your monsters with a ↑ arrow. If it has Taunt, draw 1 card.
WCG-323.zh_text: 將 1 隻敵方怪物移回手牌；它必須在你 1 隻有 ↑ 箭頭的怪物正對面。若它是嘲諷怪物，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-324.name: Flanking Rider
WCG-324.text: Charge; [Arrow: ↑] While ↑ doesn't point at a monster, this monster gets +300 PP.
WCG-324.zh_text: 衝鋒；【箭頭：↑】↑ 沒有指向怪物時，此怪物 PP +300。

WCG-325.name: Bridgebreaker Mage
WCG-325.text: [Arrow: ↑] On deploy: tap the monster ↑ points at; if there is none, draw 1 card instead. The monster ↑ points at doesn't ready at the start of a turn.
WCG-325.zh_text: 【箭頭：↑】進場：將 ↑ 指向的怪物橫置；若 ↑ 沒有指向怪物，改為抽 1 張牌。↑ 指向的怪物在回合開始時不會轉為直立。

WCG-326.name: Trailblazer Vanguard
WCG-326.text: Charge; [Arrow: ↑] On deploy: destroy the monster ↑ points at if its printed PP is 1800 or less. While ↑ doesn't point at a monster, Taunt can't stop this monster.
WCG-326.zh_text: 衝鋒；【箭頭：↑】進場：消滅 ↑ 指向的印刷 PP 1800 以下的怪物。↑ 沒有指向怪物時，嘲諷擋不住此怪物。

WCG-327.name: Thousand Roads Charge
WCG-327.text: This turn, each of your monsters with no enemy monster directly opposite gets +1 DP when attacking the enemy player.
WCG-327.zh_text: 本回合你的每隻正對面沒有敵方怪物的怪物，攻擊敵方玩家時 DP +1。

WCG-328.name: Soulstring Puppeteer
WCG-328.text: Whenever you sacrifice a monster you don't own, draw 1 card.
WCG-328.zh_text: 每當你犧牲 1 隻不是你擁有的怪物，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-329.name: Master-Devouring Pact
WCG-329.text: Additional cost: sacrifice 1 of your monsters. If you didn't own it, deal 2 damage to the enemy player; otherwise draw 1 card.
WCG-329.zh_text: 額外代價：犧牲 1 隻己方怪物。若犧牲的怪物不是你擁有的，對敵方玩家造成 2 點傷害；否則抽 1 張牌。

WCG-330.name: Bewitching Whisper
WCG-330.text: Tap 1 enemy monster with printed PP 1200 or less; if it's already tapped, gain control of it until end of turn instead (it can't attack).
WCG-330.zh_text: 將 1 隻印刷 PP 1200 以下的敵方怪物橫置；若它已經橫置，改為取得它的控制權直到回合結束（它不能攻擊）。

WCG-331.name: Borrowed Blade
WCG-331.text: Gain control of 1 enemy monster with printed PP 1800 or less until end of turn; ready it, and it can attack this turn.
WCG-331.zh_text: 取得 1 隻印刷 PP 1800 以下的敵方怪物的控制權直到回合結束；它轉為直立，本回合可以攻擊。

WCG-332.name: Puppet Warden
WCG-332.text: Taunt; On Death: gain control of the enemy monster with the lowest printed PP until the end of your next turn.
WCG-332.zh_text: 嘲諷；陣亡：取得印刷 PP 最低的 1 隻敵方怪物的控制權直到你的下回合結束。

WCG-333.name: Mindthief Adept
WCG-333.text: On deploy: gain control of 1 enemy monster with printed PP 1200 or less until end of turn; ready it, and it can attack this turn. If the enemy has no monsters, draw 1 card instead.
WCG-333.zh_text: 進場：取得 1 隻印刷 PP 1200 以下的敵方怪物的控制權直到回合結束；它轉為直立，本回合可以攻擊。若敵方沒有怪物，改為抽 1 張牌。

WCG-334.name: Bloodrite Puppetmaster
WCG-334.text: At the end of your turn, you may sacrifice a monster you took from your opponent; if you do, destroy 1 enemy monster with printed PP 1200 or less.
WCG-334.zh_text: 你的回合結束時，你可以犧牲 1 隻你從對手那裡奪來的怪物；若你這麼做，消滅 1 隻印刷 PP 1200 以下的敵方怪物。

WCG-335.name: Usurp the Throne
WCG-335.text: Move 1 enemy monster to an empty slot on your side (keeping it upright or tapped) and put a soul counter on it: you control it permanently. Can't be cast if you have no empty slot. If that monster is Silenced or Dispelled, remove the soul counter and it returns to its owner.
WCG-335.zh_text: 將 1 隻敵方怪物移到你場上 1 個空格（保持原本的直立或橫置），在它上面放置 1 個奪魂指示物：你永久控制它。你場上沒有空格時不能施放。那隻怪物被沉默或驅散時，移除奪魂指示物，控制權歸還擁有者。

WCG-336.name: Puppet's Return
WCG-336.text: Return 1 monster you control but don't own to its owner's hand and draw 2 cards. If you have none, return 1 of your monsters to your hand and draw 1 card instead.
WCG-336.zh_text: 將 1 隻你控制、但不是你擁有的怪物移回其擁有者的手牌，抽 2 張牌。若你沒有這樣的怪物，改為將 1 隻己方怪物移回手牌，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-337.name: Gladiator Calf
WCG-337.text: Whenever this monster survives combat, put 1 DP counter on it.
WCG-337.zh_text: 每當此怪物交戰後仍在場，在此怪物上放置 1 個 DP 指示物。

WCG-338.name: Heavy Horseshoe
WCG-338.text: Attach to 1 of your monsters: it gets +1 DP and +200 PP.
WCG-338.zh_text: 附著於 1 隻己方怪物：它 DP +1、PP +200。

WCG-339.name: Rock-Plated Rhino King
WCG-339.text: At the end of your turn, if this monster is upright, put 1 DP counter on it.
WCG-339.zh_text: 你的回合結束時，若此怪物直立，在此怪物上放置 1 個 DP 指示物。

WCG-340.name: Fence-Breaking Charge
WCG-340.text: Choose 1 of your monsters with 3 or more DP: Taunt can't block it this turn. If you have none, put 1 DP counter on 1 of your monsters instead.
WCG-340.zh_text: 選 1 隻 DP 3 以上的己方怪物：本回合嘲諷擋不住它。若你沒有 DP 3 以上的怪物，改為在 1 隻己方怪物上放置 1 個 DP 指示物。

WCG-341.name: Raging Hoof Warrior
WCG-341.text: Charge. When this monster attacks the enemy player, it gets +1 DP for each of your other monsters with 2 or more DP.
WCG-341.zh_text: 衝鋒；此怪物攻擊敵方玩家時，你場上每有 1 隻 DP 2 以上的其他怪物，此怪物 DP +1。

WCG-342.name: Wildland Arena
WCG-342.text: Whenever one of your monsters destroys an enemy monster in combat and is still on the field, put 1 DP counter on it.
WCG-342.zh_text: 每當你的怪物在交戰中消滅敵方怪物後仍在場，在它上面放置 1 個 DP 指示物。

WCG-343.name: Ironhide Behemoth
WCG-343.text: Taunt. When this monster attacks, if it has 3 or more DP, the monster it fights gets -500 PP.
WCG-343.zh_text: 嘲諷；此怪物攻擊時，若它的 DP 在 3 以上，與它交戰的怪物 PP -500。

WCG-344.name: Stampede of Hooves
WCG-344.text: Put 1 DP counter on each of your monsters. Draw 1 card.
WCG-344.zh_text: 在你的每隻怪物上各放置 1 個 DP 指示物。抽 1 張牌。

WCG-345.name: Lethal Ram
WCG-345.text: Double 1 of your monsters' DP this turn. If that makes its DP 4 or more, Taunt can't block it this turn.
WCG-345.zh_text: 使 1 隻己方怪物本回合 DP 變成兩倍；若它的 DP 因此在 4 以上，本回合嘲諷擋不住它。

WCG-346.name: Grave Codex Scribe
WCG-346.text: On deploy: put the top 3 cards of your deck into your graveyard.
WCG-346.zh_text: 進場：將你牌庫最上面 3 張牌送入墓地。

WCG-347.name: Ranked Dead Soldier
WCG-347.text: This monster gets +300 PP for every 5 cards in your graveyard. [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +200 PP.
WCG-347.zh_text: 你的墓地每有 5 張牌，此怪物 PP +300；【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +200。

WCG-348.name: Funeral Command
WCG-348.text: Additional cost: sacrifice 1 of your monsters. Draw 2 cards, then put the top 2 cards of your deck into your graveyard.
WCG-348.zh_text: 額外代價：犧牲 1 隻己方怪物。抽 2 張牌，將你牌庫最上面 2 張牌送入墓地。

WCG-349.name: Bone Standard
WCG-349.text: Active: tap this card and shuffle 3 other cards from your graveyard to the bottom of your deck: summon 1 monster with printed PP 1200 or less from your graveyard for free.
WCG-349.zh_text: 主動：橫置此卡，把你墓地的另外 3 張牌洗回牌庫底：從你的墓地免費召喚 1 隻印刷 PP 1200 以下的怪物。

WCG-350.name: Underworld Oath Judge
WCG-350.text: On deploy: if you have 10 or more cards in your graveyard, destroy 1 enemy monster. [Arrow: ↑] The monster the arrow points at gets -200 PP for every 5 cards in your graveyard.
WCG-350.zh_text: 進場：若你的墓地有 10 張以上，消滅 1 隻敵方怪物。【箭頭：↑】你的墓地每有 5 張牌，箭頭指向的怪物 PP -200。

WCG-351.name: Undying Phalanx
WCG-351.text: Taunt. On Death: if you have 8 or more cards in your graveyard, summon this monster from your graveyard to an empty slot of yours for free (once per turn).
WCG-351.zh_text: 嘲諷；陣亡：若你的墓地有 8 張以上，從你的墓地免費召喚此怪物到你的空格（每回合限 1 次）。

WCG-352.name: Roll Call of the Dead
WCG-352.text: Deal 1 damage to the enemy player for every 4 cards in your graveyard (up to 3).
WCG-352.zh_text: 你的墓地每有 4 張牌，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害（最多 3 點）。

WCG-353.name: Graveearth Colossus
WCG-353.text: Trample. This card costs 1 less for each monster card in your graveyard.
WCG-353.zh_text: 貫穿；你的墓地每有 1 張怪物牌，此卡費用 -1。

WCG-354.name: Return of Ten Thousand Bones
WCG-354.text: Summon monsters with printed PP 1800 or less from your graveyard for free until your slots are full. Ready them; they can attack this turn.
WCG-354.zh_text: 從你的墓地免費召喚印刷 PP 1800 以下的怪物，直到你的空格全滿；它們轉為直立，本回合可以攻擊。

WCG-355.name: Tender Rootling
WCG-355.text: [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +200 PP.

WCG-356.name: Linked-Branch Warden
WCG-356.text: Taunt. While 2 or more arrows point at it, it gets 1 Holy Shield counter (1 each time this starts applying). [Arrow: ← →] Only links the rootweb; no other effect.
WCG-356.zh_text: 嘲諷；被至少 2 個箭頭指向時，獲得 1 個聖盾指示物（每次開始成立時放 1 個）。【箭頭：← →】只用來連結根脈，沒有其他效果。

WCG-357.name: Rootweb Nexus
WCG-357.text: This monster gets +400 PP for each arrow pointing at it. [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +1 DP (no counter; it ends when the arrow stops pointing at them).
WCG-357.zh_text: 每有 1 個箭頭指向此怪物，此怪物 PP +400；【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 DP +1（不放指示物，箭頭停止指向就消失）。

WCG-358.name: Leyline Echo
WCG-358.text: For each ← → arrow of your monsters pointing at another of your monsters, choose: recover 1 life or draw 1 card (up to 4 times in total).
WCG-358.zh_text: 你的怪物每有 1 個 ← → 箭頭指向你的另 1 隻怪物，選擇：回復 1 點生命或抽 1 張牌（合計最多 4 次）。

WCG-359.name: Severed-Root Backlash
WCG-359.text: [Arrow: ← →] On Death: put 1 DP counter on each monster its arrows pointed at, and deal 1 damage to the enemy player.
WCG-359.zh_text: 【箭頭：← →】陣亡：箭頭原本指向的每隻怪物各放置 1 個 DP 指示物，並對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害。

WCG-360.name: Full Canopy Camp
WCG-360.text: At the start of your turn, if all 5 of your slots are full, your monsters get +300 PP this turn and you draw 1 card.
WCG-360.zh_text: 你的回合開始時，若你的 5 格全滿，你的所有怪物本回合 PP +300，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-361.name: Entwining Treant
WCG-361.text: On deploy: you may return 1 of your monsters to your hand. [Arrow: ← → ↑] The monsters the arrows point at get +300 PP (including the one directly across).
WCG-361.zh_text: 進場：你可以將 1 隻己方怪物移回手牌。【箭頭：← → ↑】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +300（包括 ↑ 正對面的怪物）。

WCG-362.name: Squeezing Sprout
WCG-362.text: When summoned from hand, it can only be put into an empty slot between two of your monsters. [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +300 PP.
WCG-362.zh_text: 從手牌召喚時，只能放在兩隻己方怪物之間的空格。【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +300。

WCG-363.name: Heart of the World Tree
WCG-363.text: On deploy: put 1 DP counter on each of your monsters that an arrow points at. [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +600 PP; a monster entering a slot the arrows point at enters upright (it can attack that turn).
WCG-363.zh_text: 進場：你每隻被箭頭指向的怪物各放置 1 個 DP 指示物。【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +600；進入箭頭指向格子的怪物直立進場（當回合可以攻擊）。

WCG-364.name: Blood Oath Altar
WCG-364.text: Each time you take damage, put 1 Blood Oath counter on this card. When this card leaves play, the Blood Oath counters on it are removed with it.
WCG-364.zh_text: 你每次受到傷害，在此卡放 1 個血誓指示物。此卡離開戰場時，上面的血誓指示物一起移除。

WCG-365.name: Enduring Oathguard
WCG-365.text: Each time you take damage, put 1 DP counter on this monster.
WCG-365.zh_text: 你每次受到傷害，在此怪物放 1 個 DP 指示物。

WCG-366.name: Blood for Blood
WCG-366.text: [Counter] When you take damage: deal 1 damage to the enemy player; if your life is 3 or less, deal 2 instead.
WCG-366.zh_text: 【反擊】受到傷害時：對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害；若你的生命在 3 點以下，改為 2 點。

WCG-367.name: Wrath of the Oath
WCG-367.text: Charge. While your life is 3 or less, this monster gets +600 PP and +1 DP. [Arrow: ↑] The monster the arrow points at gets -300 PP.
WCG-367.zh_text: 衝鋒；你的生命在 3 點以下時，此怪物 PP +600、DP +1。【箭頭：↑】箭頭指向的怪物 PP -300。

WCG-368.name: Shield of Judgment
WCG-368.text: [Counter] When you take damage from a monster's attack: destroy that monster, then put 1 Blood Oath counter on 1 of your Blood Oath Altars.
WCG-368.zh_text: 【反擊】受到怪物攻擊的傷害時：消滅那隻怪物，然後在你的 1 張血誓祭壇放 1 個血誓指示物。

WCG-369.name: Oathbound Zealot
WCG-369.text: On Deploy: deal 1 damage to yourself (this is damage, so it triggers Counters and Blood Oath), then draw 1 card.
WCG-369.zh_text: 進場：對你自己造成 1 點傷害（這是傷害，會觸發反擊與血誓），然後抽 1 張牌。

WCG-370.name: Settling the Blood Debt
WCG-370.text: Remove any number of Blood Oath counters from your side of the field: for every 2 removed, destroy 1 enemy monster (any PP).
WCG-370.zh_text: 移除你場上任意數量的血誓指示物：每移除 2 個，消滅 1 隻敵方怪物（不限 PP）。

WCG-371.name: Bloodoath Standard-Bearer
WCG-371.text: [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +200 PP, plus another +200 for each life you have less than your opponent.
WCG-371.zh_text: 【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +200；你的生命每比對手少 1 點，再 +200。

WCG-372.name: Thousandfold Return
WCG-372.text: Remove all Blood Oath counters from your side of the field. Deal 1 damage to the enemy player for each one removed.
WCG-372.zh_text: 移除你場上所有血誓指示物，每移除 1 個，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害。

WCG-373.name: Tidepool Gatherer
WCG-373.text: On deploy: recover 1 life and draw 1 card.
WCG-373.zh_text: 進場：回復 1 點生命，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-374.name: Ebbcall Sorcerer
WCG-374.text: On deploy: you may return another of your monsters to your hand. If you do, the next monster you summon by paying this turn costs 1 less.
WCG-374.zh_text: 進場：你可以將另 1 隻己方怪物移回手牌；若你這麼做，本回合你下一張付費召喚的怪物費用 -1。

WCG-375.name: Receding Wave
WCG-375.text: Return 1 of your monsters to your hand. If its printed cost is 3 or more, draw 1 card.
WCG-375.zh_text: 將 1 隻己方怪物移回手牌。若它的印刷費用 3 以上，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-376.name: Sporetide Envoy
WCG-376.text: On deploy: put 1 DP counter on each monster the arrows point at. [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +200 PP.
WCG-376.zh_text: 進場：箭頭指向的怪物各放置 1 個 DP 指示物。【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +200。

WCG-377.name: Mirror Lake Sage
WCG-377.text: On deploy: look at the top 3 cards of your deck, put 1 into your hand and the rest on the bottom in any order.
WCG-377.zh_text: 進場：從你的牌庫檢視最上面 3 張，取 1 張加入手牌，其餘依任意順序放回牌庫底。

WCG-378.name: Ring of Recurrence
WCG-378.text: Whenever you return one of your monsters to your hand, draw 1 card (at most twice per turn).
WCG-378.zh_text: 每當你將己方怪物移回手牌，抽 1 張牌（每回合最多 2 次）。

WCG-379.name: Floodtide Tortoise
WCG-379.text: Taunt. On deploy: recover 2 life and draw 1 card. The first time each turn you return one of your monsters to your hand, this card costs 2 less in your hand until end of turn.
WCG-379.zh_text: 嘲諷；進場：回復 2 點生命，抽 1 張牌。你每回合第一次將己方怪物移回手牌時，此卡在你手牌中的費用 -2 直到回合結束。

WCG-380.name: Thoughtcurrent Catcher
WCG-380.text: On deploy: return 1 enemy monster to its hand. [Arrow: ↑] The monster the arrow points at gets -300 PP.
WCG-380.zh_text: 進場：將 1 隻敵方怪物移回手牌。【箭頭：↑】箭頭指向的怪物 PP -300。

WCG-381.name: Return of All Tides
WCG-381.text: Return all your monsters to your hand and draw 1 card for each one returned. This turn, monsters you summon by paying cost 2 less (to a minimum of 0).
WCG-381.zh_text: 將你場上所有怪物移回手牌，每收回 1 隻抽 1 張牌。本回合你付費召喚的怪物費用 -2（最低 0）。

WCG-382.name: Sporebog Crawler
WCG-382.text: Poison. On death: put 1 Corrosion counter on 1 enemy monster.
WCG-382.zh_text: 劇毒；陣亡：在 1 隻敵方怪物上放置 1 個腐蝕指示物。

WCG-383.name: Rotmist Spreader
WCG-383.text: On deploy: put 1 Corrosion counter on 1 enemy monster. [Arrow: ↑] At the end of your turn, put 1 Corrosion counter on the monster the arrow points at.
WCG-383.zh_text: 進場：在 1 隻敵方怪物上放置 1 個腐蝕指示物。【箭頭：↑】你的回合結束時，在箭頭指向的怪物上放置 1 個腐蝕指示物。

WCG-384.name: Spreading Spore Cloud
WCG-384.text: Put 1 Corrosion counter on each enemy monster.
WCG-384.zh_text: 在每隻敵方怪物上各放置 1 個腐蝕指示物。

WCG-385.name: Rotroot Stalker
WCG-385.text: Poison. When it attacks a monster with a Corrosion counter, this monster gets +500 PP until end of turn.
WCG-385.zh_text: 劇毒；攻擊有腐蝕指示物的怪物時，此怪物 PP +500 直到回合結束。

WCG-386.name: Bogmother's Brood
WCG-386.text: At the start of your turn, put 1 Corrosion counter on 1 enemy monster. If it already has 3 or more, destroy it instead.
WCG-386.zh_text: 你的回合開始時，在 1 隻敵方怪物上放置 1 個腐蝕指示物；若該怪物已有 3 個以上，改為消滅它。

WCG-387.name: Corpsecap Spreader
WCG-387.text: On deploy: put 1 DP counter on each monster the arrows point at. On death: put 2 Corrosion counters divided among enemy monsters. [Arrow: ← →] The monsters the arrows point at get +200 PP.
WCG-387.zh_text: 進場：在箭頭指向的每隻怪物上各放置 1 個 DP 指示物。陣亡：在敵方怪物上分配放置 2 個腐蝕指示物。【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物 PP +200。

WCG-388.name: Rotting Harvest
WCG-388.text: Destroy 1 enemy monster with 2 or more Corrosion counters. If there is none, put 2 Corrosion counters on 1 enemy monster instead.
WCG-388.zh_text: 消滅 1 隻有 2 個以上腐蝕指示物的敵方怪物；若沒有，改為在 1 隻敵方怪物上放置 2 個腐蝕指示物。

WCG-389.name: Miasma Maw
WCG-389.text: Trample. On deploy: deal 1 damage to the enemy player for each Corrosion counter on the enemy's side of the field (at most 3).
WCG-389.zh_text: 貫穿；進場：敵方場上每有 1 個腐蝕指示物，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害（最多 3 點）。

WCG-390.name: Mother of All Rot
WCG-390.text: Poison. On deploy: put 2 Corrosion counters on each enemy monster, then destroy every enemy monster whose current PP is 0 or less.
WCG-390.zh_text: 劇毒；進場：在每隻敵方怪物上各放置 2 個腐蝕指示物，然後消滅所有當下 PP 0 以下的敵方怪物。

WCG-391.name: Twinstrike Recruit
WCG-391.text: After this monster's first attack each turn, if it is still on the field, ready it.
WCG-391.zh_text: 此怪物每回合第一次攻擊後，若它還在場，轉為直立。

WCG-392.name: Rallying Warcry
WCG-392.text: Ready 1 of your monsters. It gets +300 PP until end of turn.
WCG-392.zh_text: 將 1 隻己方怪物轉為直立，它 PP +300 直到回合結束。

WCG-393.name: War Drum Herald
WCG-393.text: [Arrow: ← →] After a monster the arrows point at attacks, if it is still on the field, it gets +200 PP until end of turn.
WCG-393.zh_text: 【箭頭：← →】箭頭指向的怪物攻擊後，若它還在場，PP +200 直到回合結束。

WCG-394.name: Chain Brawler
WCG-394.text: Charge. After this monster attacks and destroys an enemy monster, ready it (at most twice per turn).
WCG-394.zh_text: 衝鋒；此怪物攻擊並消滅敵方怪物後，轉為直立（每回合最多 2 次）。

WCG-395.name: Restless Forge
WCG-395.text: Active: tap this card: ready 1 of your tapped monsters.
WCG-395.zh_text: 主動：橫置此卡：將 1 隻己方已橫置的怪物轉為直立。

WCG-396.name: Frenzied Stride
WCG-396.text: Ready all your tapped monsters. They can't attack the enemy player this turn.
WCG-396.zh_text: 將所有己方已橫置的怪物轉為直立；它們本回合不能攻擊敵方玩家。

WCG-397.name: Bloodwave Swordmaster
WCG-397.text: Trample. This monster gets +400 PP for each time it has attacked this turn (until end of turn).
WCG-397.zh_text: 貫穿；本回合此怪物每攻擊過 1 次，PP +400（直到回合結束）。

WCG-398.name: Battlefield Horn
WCG-398.text: Taunt. During your turn, the first of your monsters that attacks and is still on the field afterwards is readied (once per turn). [Arrow: ↑] The monster the arrow points at gets -300 PP.
WCG-398.zh_text: 嘲諷；你的回合中，第一隻攻擊後仍在場的己方怪物轉為直立（每回合 1 次）。【箭頭：↑】箭頭指向的怪物 PP -300。

WCG-399.name: Thousand-Blade Surge
WCG-399.text: Charge. Trample. After each attack, if this monster is still on the field, ready it (at most 3 times per turn).
WCG-399.zh_text: 衝鋒；貫穿；此怪物每次攻擊後，若它還在場，轉為直立（每回合最多 3 次）。

WCG-400.name: Wellspring Nun
WCG-400.zh_text: 進場：回復你 1 點生命。

WCG-401.name: Springlight Acolyte
WCG-401.text: [Arrows: ← →] Whenever you heal, the monsters the arrows point at get +300 PP this turn.
WCG-401.zh_text: 【箭頭：← →】每當你回復生命，箭頭指向的怪物本回合 PP +300。

WCG-402.name: Overflowing Prayer
WCG-402.text: You heal 2 life. If your life was already 7 before healing, also draw 1 card.
WCG-402.zh_text: 回復你 2 點生命；若回復前你的生命已是 7，再抽 1 張牌。

WCG-403.name: Holy Spring Well
WCG-403.text: Whenever you heal, put Holy Spring counters on this card equal to the amount healed (healing beyond your maximum life counts too). Active: tap this card and remove 2 Holy Spring counters from it: draw 1 card. When this card leaves play, its Holy Spring counters go with it.
WCG-403.zh_text: 每當你回復生命，在此卡放置等同回復量的聖泉指示物（超過生命上限、沒有回到的部分也算）。主動：橫置此卡，移除此卡 2 個聖泉指示物：抽 1 張牌。此卡離開戰場時，上面的聖泉指示物一起移除。

WCG-404.name: Wandering Healer
WCG-404.text: At the end of your turn, you heal 1 life.
WCG-404.zh_text: 你的回合結束時，回復你 1 點生命。

WCG-405.name: Spring-Sworn Knight
WCG-405.text: Taunt. Whenever you heal, put 1 DP counter on this monster (at most twice per turn).
WCG-405.zh_text: 嘲諷；每當你回復生命，在此怪物放置 1 個 DP 指示物（每回合最多 2 次）。

WCG-406.name: Tide of Baptism
WCG-406.text: You heal 2 life. Then 1 enemy monster gets -300 PP for each life you healed this turn until end of turn; if this makes its PP 0, destroy it.
WCG-406.zh_text: 回復你 2 點生命。然後 1 隻敵方怪物 PP -（本回合你回復的生命總量 ×300）直到回合結束；若它的 PP 因此變為 0，消滅它。

WCG-407.name: Silverspring Colossus
WCG-407.text: Taunt. On deploy: you heal 3 life. At the start of your turn, if your life is 7, deal 1 damage to the enemy player.
WCG-407.zh_text: 嘲諷；進場：回復你 3 點生命。你的回合開始時，若你的生命是 7，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害。

WCG-408.name: Holy Spring Deluge
WCG-408.text: You heal 2 life. Then remove all Holy Spring counters you have; deal 1 damage to the enemy player for every 2 removed.
WCG-408.zh_text: 回復你 2 點生命。然後移除你場上所有聖泉指示物，每移除 2 個，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害。

WCG-409.name: Starsand Apprentice
WCG-409.text: On deploy: put 1 Countdown counter on this monster. When its last Countdown counter is removed: draw 2 cards.
WCG-409.zh_text: 進場：在此怪物放置 1 個倒數指示物。移除最後 1 個倒數指示物時：抽 2 張牌。

WCG-410.name: Inverted Clock
WCG-410.text: On entering: put 3 Countdown counters on this card. When its last Countdown counter is removed: destroy 1 enemy monster, then put 3 Countdown counters on this card again.
WCG-410.zh_text: 進場：在此卡放置 3 個倒數指示物。移除最後 1 個倒數指示物時：消滅 1 隻敵方怪物，然後在此卡再放置 3 個倒數指示物。

WCG-411.name: Stargazer Adept
WCG-411.text: [Arrows: ← →] At the start of your turn, the cards the arrows point at (monsters or structures) each remove 1 extra Countdown counter.
WCG-411.zh_text: 【箭頭：← →】你的回合開始時，箭頭指向的卡（怪物或結界）各額外移除 1 個倒數指示物。

WCG-412.name: Time-Gap Catalyst
WCG-412.text: Remove 2 Countdown counters from 1 card you control. If you have no Countdown counters, draw 1 card instead.
WCG-412.zh_text: 從你場上 1 張卡移除 2 個倒數指示物。若你場上沒有倒數指示物，改為抽 1 張牌。

WCG-413.name: Timeseal Warden
WCG-413.text: Taunt. On deploy: put 2 Countdown counters on this monster. While it has Countdown counters, it can't be targeted by spells. When its last Countdown counter is removed: put 2 DP counters and 1 Divine Shield counter on this monster.
WCG-413.zh_text: 嘲諷；進場：在此怪物放置 2 個倒數指示物。此怪物有倒數指示物時，不能成為法術的目標。移除最後 1 個倒數指示物時：在此怪物放置 2 個 DP 指示物與 1 個聖盾指示物。

WCG-414.name: Meteor Seer
WCG-414.text: On deploy: put 2 Countdown counters on this monster. When its last Countdown counter is removed: deal 2 damage to the enemy player and destroy every enemy monster with printed PP 900 or less.
WCG-414.zh_text: 進場：在此怪物放置 2 個倒數指示物。移除最後 1 個倒數指示物時：對敵方玩家造成 2 點傷害，並消滅所有印刷 PP 900 以下的敵方怪物。

WCG-415.name: Star-Orbit Realignment
WCG-415.text: Put 2 Countdown counters on 1 card you control that has no Countdown counters and whose text says "When its last Countdown counter is removed" (it can trigger again). If there is no such card, draw 1 card instead.
WCG-415.zh_text: 在你場上 1 張沒有倒數指示物、卡面有「移除最後 1 個倒數指示物時」的卡上放置 2 個倒數指示物（它之後可以再觸發一次）。若沒有這樣的卡，改為抽 1 張牌。

WCG-416.name: Eternal Clocktower
WCG-416.text: Whenever a card you control has its last Countdown counter removed, draw 1 card and heal 1 life.
WCG-416.zh_text: 每當你場上的卡移除最後 1 個倒數指示物，抽 1 張牌並回復你 1 點生命。

WCG-417.name: End of the Star Law
WCG-417.text: Remove all Countdown counters from cards you control (they trigger one by one, left to right). Deal 1 damage to the enemy player for each card that triggers this way. If none trigger, draw 3 cards instead.
WCG-417.zh_text: 移除你場上所有倒數指示物（由左到右逐張觸發）。每因此觸發 1 張，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害。若沒有任何觸發，改為抽 3 張牌。

WCG-418.name: Bone-Casting Child
WCG-418.text: On deploy: reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a monster, draw 1 card.
WCG-418.zh_text: 進場：翻開你牌庫頂 1 張；若是怪物，抽 1 張牌。

WCG-419.name: Wheel-of-Fate Diviner
WCG-419.text: At the start of your turn, reveal the top card of your deck: monster — this monster gets +500 PP this turn; spell — deal 1 damage to the enemy player; structure — you heal 1 life.
WCG-419.zh_text: 你的回合開始時，翻開你牌庫頂 1 張：怪物——此怪物本回合 PP +500；法術——對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害；結界——回復你 1 點生命。

WCG-420.name: Abyssal Wager
WCG-420.text: Reveal the top card of your deck. 1 enemy monster gets -300 PP times that card's printed cost until end of turn; if this makes its PP 0, destroy it.
WCG-420.zh_text: 翻開你牌庫頂 1 張，1 隻敵方怪物 PP -（翻開那張的印刷費用 ×300）直到回合結束；若它的 PP 因此變為 0，消滅它。

WCG-421.name: Well of Open Eyes
WCG-421.text: Active: tap this card and reveal the top card of your deck. You may lose 1 life (a life cost) to put it into your hand.
WCG-421.zh_text: 主動：橫置此卡，翻開你牌庫頂 1 張；你可以失去 1 點生命（生命代價），把它加入手牌。

WCG-422.name: Soul-Dice Golem
WCG-422.text: On deploy: reveal the top card of your deck. If its printed cost is 4 or more, destroy the monster the arrow points at. [Arrow: ↑] The monster the arrow points at gets -200 PP.
WCG-422.zh_text: 進場：翻開你牌庫頂 1 張；若它的印刷費用 4 以上，消滅箭頭指向的怪物。【箭頭：↑】箭頭指向的怪物 PP -200。

WCG-423.name: Fate Scavenger
WCG-423.text: Whenever you reveal a card: if it's a spell, put 1 DP counter on this monster; if it's a monster, this monster gets +300 PP this turn.
WCG-423.zh_text: 每當你翻開牌：若是法術，在此怪物放置 1 個 DP 指示物；若是怪物，此怪物本回合 PP +300。

WCG-424.name: Black-Lot Summoner
WCG-424.text: On deploy: reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a monster and you have an empty slot, summon it from your deck for free (its deploy doesn't trigger). Otherwise, draw 1 card.
WCG-424.zh_text: 進場：翻開你牌庫頂 1 張；若是怪物且你有空格，從牌庫免費召喚它（不觸發進場）；否則抽 1 張牌。

WCG-425.name: Altar of Fate
WCG-425.text: Whenever you reveal a card with printed cost 5 or more, deal 1 damage to the enemy player.
WCG-425.zh_text: 每當你翻開印刷費用 5 以上的牌，對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害。

WCG-426.name: Thousand-Faced Roulette
WCG-426.text: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck one at a time and resolve every one by type: monster — summon it from your deck for free (its deploy doesn't trigger; if you have no empty slot, put it into your hand); spell — deal 1 damage to the enemy player; structure — draw 1 card.
WCG-426.zh_text: 翻開你牌庫頂 4 張（一次 1 張），全部依類型結算：怪物——從牌庫免費召喚它（不觸發進場；沒有空格就加入手牌）；法術——對敵方玩家造成 1 點傷害；結界——抽 1 張牌。
